title: S28 — v3 on the dead families' truth-mask glyphs: letter identity under corrosion-grade noise + rotated cards (the image-side lane go/no-go)
desc: S27 left exactly one instrument untested on the two families that are dead to the classic pipeline (0/16 with truth masks): trained glyph recognition. glyphcnn-v3 exists (89.2% glyph val) and S26 closed DIGIT identity under corrosion (34.7%) — but LETTER identity on the actual truth-mask glyphs (heavy-stroke pitted corrosion renders; collage's rotated card text) is unmeasured. Method: reuse S27's oracle constructions (rng-faithful), segment glyphs from the truth masks with the reader's own segmentation, feed the crops to glyphcnn-v3, measure per-glyph accuracy vs the label. Two outcomes, both decisive: (a) v3 reads them → the image-side lane is LIVE (mask work + v3 per-glyph has a measured foundation); (b) v3 fails too → the 95-bar is honestly unreachable with current instruments and the room should know that now. Small probe, no pipeline change. Parent: t-20261011-88dc.
